info.title: raptor21-openapi
info.description: Command line generator that turns an OpenAPI document carrying generic contract metadata into a Refit client with its generic envelopes intact.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Generates a typed client from an OpenAPI document, restoring the generic response
contracts the document carries as metadata instead of redefining them.

options.name: --output
options.description:
C#: write to a file instead of standard output.
TypeScript: a directory to write types.ts/client.ts/(queries.ts) into.

options.name: --queries
options.description: TypeScript only: also emit queries.ts with TanStack Query hooks.

options.name: --body-name
options.description: TypeScript only: name of the request-body parameter. Default: request.

options.name: --optional-body
options.description:
TypeScript only: keep a body optional when the document does not mark
it required (default treats every body as required — see README).

options.name: --namespace
options.description: C# namespace for generated code. Default: GeneratedClient.

options.name: --single-interface
options.description: Emit one interface/client for the whole document instead of one per tag.

options.name: --no-headers
options.description: Leave every header parameter out of generated signatures.

options.name: --skip-header
options.description: Leave one header parameter out. Repeatable.

options.name: --exclude-tag
options.description: Skip every operation carrying this tag. Repeatable.

options.name: --payload-property
options.description: Envelope property holding the payload. Default: data.

options.name: --path-prefix
options.description:
Prepend this to every route, for a service reached through a
gateway that mounts it under a prefix.

options.name: --map
options.description: Map a projected contract type onto a local one. Repeatable.

options.name: --using
options.description: C#: extra using directive in the generated file. Repeatable.

options.name: --di
options.description:
C#: also emit an extension method registering every interface as a
Refit client. Needs Refit.HttpClientFactory in the target project.

options.name: --registration-method
options.description: C#: name for that method. Default: AddGeneratedApis. Implies --di.

options.name: --no-cancellation-tokens
options.description: C#: omit the trailing CancellationToken parameter.
